Real values

The sections below compare nominal (default) results to the same specification estimated on real (deflated) values of the dependent variable. Nominal columns load from on-disk .ster files; real columns currently pull headline values from a bank scraped from the RP6-real Stata logs (see tools/results_overview/scrape_logs.py). Once we re-run the M4 real pipeline locally, the bank fallback will be replaced with on-disk _r-suffix .ster files, and the runtime row will populate.
